lookup_method: Live Hugging Face public model/dataset/Space page verification via current web search. Repository CLI execution from this automation environment is not independently executed; this report does not claim CLI-run provenance.
license_policy: Permissive licenses marked permitted; CC BY permitted with attribution; missing/unclear license => REVIEW_REQUIRED; non-commercial => LICENSE_NOT_PERMITTED/REJECT for commercial/internal product path.

snunlp/KR-FinBert-SC.reason: Korean financial-domain sentiment model trained with Korean economic news and analyst reports; strong fit for Korea-market/news tone.
warnings: License metadata was not shown on the live page; legal/license review required before adoption.

peyterho/financial-roberta-large-macro-s.runtime: 355M params; ~1.5GB GPU memory noted by model card; higher latency than FinBERT
peyterho/financial-roberta-large-macro-s.reason: Financial/macro/policy sentiment specialist suited to central-bank, macro and catalyst text.
warnings: English only; 128-token fine-tuning limit, so long documents need chunking.

ENTUM-AI/FinBERT-Multi.reason: Financial sentiment model trained across five finance datasets; practical news/catalyst classifier.
warnings: English only; self-reported model performance should be independently benchmarked.

BAAI/bge-m3.reason: Strong multilingual embedding/retrieval backbone for Korean-English financial document retrieval and evidence matching.
warnings: General retrieval model, not finance-specific; benchmark on financial corpus before production ranking.

BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3.reason: High-use multilingual cross-encoder reranker for evidence ranking and source verification.
warnings: Not finance-specific; evaluate latency and relevance on financial filings/news.

MoritzLaurer/DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-.reason: NLI model trained with MNLI/FEVER/ANLI; strong candidate for contradiction/evidence-consistency checks.
warnings: English-first; use as verification aid, not deterministic truth oracle.

ibm-granite/granite-timeseries-ttm-r1.reason: Very lightweight multivariate time-series foundation model; good for quant/regime/money-flow experimentation.
warnings: R1 open-source model card emphasizes minutely/hourly resolutions; daily/weekly stock use requires validation or newer variants.

amazon/chronos-t5-small.reason: General probabilistic time-series forecasting foundation model suitable for price/volume/macro series experiments.
warnings: Forecasting model is not a trading strategy; must be evaluated with walk-forward, leakage-safe market data.

Salesforce/moirai-1.1-R-small.reason: Technically strong compact universal forecaster; useful only as a benchmark reference for this project.
warnings: CC BY-NC 4.0 is non-commercial; blocked by commercial/internal product license gate unless legal scope explicitly approves.

microsoft/table-transformer-detection.runtime: Object detection model; GPU helpful for document batches
microsoft/table-transformer-detection.reason: Table detection for financial reports before OCR/table extraction and financial QA.
warnings: Detection only; table structure/OCR still needs downstream components.

Mr-Rosen/Accuracy-Is-Not-Enough-FinQA-Da.reason: Long-context FinQA derivative preserving numerical reasoning over financial tables and text.
warnings: Attribution required; benchmark data should not be treated as current market data.

trismik/fpb-fiqasa.reason: Compact benchmark combining Financial PhraseBank and FiQA sentiment for finance-news sentiment validation.
warnings: Evaluation dataset scale is small; attribution required.

ArnabDeo/ai-stock-predictor.runtime: Gradio demo; uses Chronos & Moirai per README
ArnabDeo/ai-stock-predictor.reason: Reusable stock-prediction demo Space showing Chronos/Moirai integration patterns.
warnings: Demo/reference only; model dependencies include Moirai whose own model license may be non-commercial. Audit app.py and dependencies before reuse.

roles.selection_note: Use KR-FinBert-SC only after license review; BGE-M3 for bilingual retrieval; macro RoBERTa for English/global policy context.
TTM first for lightweight anomaly/forecast prototypes; Chronos as second forecaster; Moirai blocked by NC license.
Macro/policy sentiment plus two permissive time-series foundations for rates/FX/index features.
FinBERT-Multi for tone; BGE-M3 + reranker for retrieval/evidence prioritization; FPB-FiQASA for validation.
TTM/Chronos are primary research candidates; Space is code-pattern reference only pending dependency audit.
NLI for contradiction, reranker for evidence ordering, embeddings for multilingual evidence retrieval.
FinQA benchmark + table detection + multilingual retrieval support for financial statements.
Use permissive TTM/Chronos; retain Moirai only as a blocked benchmark reference.
Blend numerical regime features from time-series models with macro/policy text sentiment.
Catalyst tone + macro context + reranking, with finance-sentiment benchmark for regression testing.
NLI and macro text models provide explanatory checks; deterministic core remains the final risk gate; FinQA for reasoning evaluation.

validation_notes: All 11 requested roles are mapped to 3-4 live-verified Hugging Face resources.
Non-commercial Moirai candidate is explicitly blocked.
KR-FinBert-SC is not auto-selected because the live page did not expose a license.
Model/Space quality and financial suitability require project-specific benchmark evaluation before production adoption.
No model output should bypass deterministic risk controls or source verification.

watch_snapshot_proposal.cadence: daily for active shortlist; weekly for benchmark-only resources
